lyrics:
[Intro: steel pan notes, soft kick, party noise far away]

[Verse 1: quiet female voice, close]
I take my glass to the quiet end
Past the speakers, past the bend
I'm not hiding, I'm just here
Where a person could be clear

[Chorus: choir bursts in, wide and joyful]
I have never been so easy to find
Come on down, come on down
I have never been so easy to find
Come on down

[Verse 2: quiet voice, bass under]
Loud is fine for other people
I like water I can hear
If you're looking, look for stillness
I'm the one not moving near

[Chorus: choir, handclaps, steel pan answering]
I have never been so easy to find
Come on down, come on down
I have never been so easy to find
Come on down

[Break: quiet voice alone]
You found it.
Hi.

[Final Chorus: choir and quiet voice together]
I have never been so easy to find
Come on down, come on down
I have never been so easy to find
You came down

[Outro: steel pan, two glasses touching]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 107 BPM, 4/4, A major. Slow, spacious and bittersweet, with bursts of joy.

VOICE: A woman sings the verses very quietly, almost speaking, low and close. The chorus is a mixed soul choir, bright and full, sounding as if lifted from a 1970s record. They sing together only at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: Steel pans, a soft kick and a dry clap, a deep sustained bass, a clean guitar playing single notes, strings in the choruses, handclaps, distant party noise.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, steel pan. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:46 Chorus 1, choir. 1:10 Verse 2. 1:40 Chorus 2. 2:06 Break, two spoken words. 2:20 Final chorus, together. 2:50 Outro, steel pan and glasses, ends 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s British electronic: sparse and dry in the verses, warm and saturated in the choruses, a lot of space.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The choir bursting in at 0:46.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 8 p.m. A slow track with a big, warm chorus, for the hour when the deck fills up.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Apart, hopeful, found, together.
